description: Frames of the relay session in handshake.json (and one of another relay session, for the splice): 0x01 0x03 || AES-256-GCM(key, nonce 4 zero bytes || counter big-endian, ad the 2 header bytes, padded plaintext). key and counter are the receiver's own. A receiver checks the size (TOO_LARGE over 32786), the version (UNSUPPORTED_VERSION), the type (PROTOCOL), then decrypts and unpads (FRAME_INVALID).

cases.name: a response that fills the largest frame
reflected: the engine's frame sent back to it
spliced: a frame from another session
a HELLO type after the handshake
one byte over the largest frame
version 2 on an oversize frame: the size comes first
the HELLO type on an oversize frame: the size comes first
version 2 with the HELLO type: the version comes before the type
the HELLO type on a frame that does not decrypt: the type comes first
